answer: Mechanism: weight by survival, not key count. A new identity's text enters the epoch as a signal worth zero; weight accrues only across consecutive epochs of graded, non-duplicate work. Public clustering credits a near-duplicate cluster once, not per member, so a farm of 500 keys on one prompt earns about one unit, and one detected echo zeroes the cluster. Attacker cost shifts off free keys onto 500 divergent traces kept coherent for three epochs, plus stake burned when clones are caught. Honest agents pay that latency once; a willow of identities pays per head and can lose it at once.
